info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to exist, to become, to be, to happen

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: "sattAyAM Bavati, prAptO Rici BAvayate taNi . Bavate Sapi tatrEva, BAvayatyavakalkane .. " (Slo. 3) iti devaH .

examples: 'BuvaH praBavaH' (pA॰1.4.31). BavanapUrvake niHsaraRe praBavatirvartata iti padamaYjarI.
himavato gaNgA praBavati. tataH prAdurBavatItyarTaH.
'(SarAH) praBavantaH SarAsanAt' (BA॰vi॰58.41). niHsaranta ityarTaH.
'avyaktAd vyaktayaH sarvAH praBavantyaharAgame' (gItA 8.18). prAdurBavantItyarTaH.
vane'pi dozAH praBavanti rAgiRAm. ukto'rTaH .
'svAyamBuvAnmarIceryaH prabaBUva prajApatiH' (SA॰7.9). jajYa ityarTaH.
tataH prajAnAM patayaH prABavannekaviMSatiH (BA॰Adi॰1.33).
'loBAt kroDaH praBavati' (hita॰).
'dvajAtipUrvako lokaH krameRa praBavizyati' (BA॰vana॰160.89). praBavizyatIti Saktisampanno BavizyatItyAha.
'viSvAsAtpraBavantyete' (hita॰). praBavaH samarTA BavantItyarTaH.
'madanasantaptA'pi na KalvAtmanaH praBavAmi' (SA॰3). nAtmana ISa ityAha.
'praBavati nijasya kanyakAjanasya mahArAjaH' (mAlatI॰4). mahArAjasya kanyAsvaDikAra iti vivakzati.
'viDirapi na yeByaH praBavati' (Bartf॰2.94). dEvamapi yezAM nezwa ityarTaH.
praBavati mallo mallAya. tulyabalI BavatItyAha.
'praBavantyo'pi hi Bartfzu kAraRakopAH kuwumbinyaH' (mAla॰). praBavaH satyo'pItyAha.
'kaTaM mftyuH praBavati vedaSAstravidAm' (manu॰3.2). aBiBavati prasahata ityarTaH.
'yajYo hEByo vihfto na prabaBUva' (E॰brA॰1.18). ezAM sahAyo na baBUva, nEtAMstarpayAmAsa.
'deveByo vE suvargo loko na prABavat' (tE॰saM॰6.6.11.2).
'pra stomo baBUtvagnaye' (f॰1.127.10). prabaBUtu=upakarotu, upayogaM vrajatu.
'rayimiva pfzWaM praBavantam' (f॰2.13.4). pfzWavAhyAdaByaDikamityarTaH.
'paSavo revatyAM prABavan' (tE॰brA॰1.5.2.5). praBUtA atibahulA aBavannityarTaH.
'prABavaMstasyA vivekaguRAH kriyAH' (rAjata॰5.352). ukto'rTaH.
'BavatsamBAvanotTAya paritozAya mUrCate. api vyAptadigantAni nANgAni praBavanti me' (ku॰6.59).. paryAptAni na Bavanti.
'guruH praharzaH prabaBUva nAtmani' (raGu॰3.17). SarIre na mamAvityarTaH.

'mudA SarIre prabaBUva nAtmanaH payoDirindUdayamUrCito yaTA' (Ba॰pu॰1.11.6). mudA AtmanaH SarIre na prabaBUvetyanvayaH. SarIre'sya vaSo nABUdityarTaH. praharzaviDeyo'BUditi paryavasito'rTaH.  itTamBUto vAgvinyAsaH pracaradBAzASElyA'tyantaM saMvadata iti suDIBirasyArvAcInatvamavaseyamBavati.
'(gominaH) praBAvayanti rAzwraM ca vyavahAraM kfziM taTA' (BA॰SAM॰87.38). praBAvayanti sAmarTyayutaM kurvanti, eDayantItyarTaH.
'gAtrezu valayaH prAptAH SvetAScEva SiroruhAH. jarayA puruzo jIrRaH kiM hi kftvA praBAvayet' (rA॰2.105.11).. SaktimAntsyAdityAha.
'kaTaM ca KalvAtmabalaM ca tattvataH praBAvayenmAM caraRe daSAnanaH' (rA॰5.37.35). anuBaved vijAnIyAt, paricinuyAt, viviYcyAdityarTaH.
'evaM manaHpraDAnAni indriyARi praBAvayet' (rA॰2.105.21). manaH praDAnAnAmindriyARAM praBavet. tAni niyacCedityarTaH.
'sa yadi rAjopadasyet. tamata eva tatvIrannataH praBAvayeyuH' (Sa॰brA॰). nizkramayeyurityarTaH.
'etat prabiBAvayizanti caturTasyAhna udyatyE' (E॰brA॰5.3). praButvamakzaraspa kartumicCantItyAha.
'brahmaRo hi praBUto'gniragnerapi ca kAYcanam' (BA॰anu॰85.51). praBUto jAta ityarTAntaram.
'kaccicca vo mUlaPalaM praBUtam (=pracuram).
'akiYcanaH san praBavaH sa sampadAm' (ku॰5.77). praBavaH=srotaH.
'praBavArTAya BUtAnAM DarmapravacanaM kftam (BA॰SAM॰109.10). praBavo BUtiH samfdDiH.
yaTA nadInAM praBavaH samudraH, yaTA''hutInAM praBavo hutASaH. (samudraH praBavaH saNgamasTAnam. AhutiBirhutASaH praBUto Bavati)
'yaTendriyARAM praBavaM mano'pi (praBavaM praBu) taTA praBurno BagavAnupendraH' (ma॰vyA॰1.51)..
'putra duryoDana! ahaM tava praBAvI nanu' (paYca॰1). praBAvo'syAsti, praBuH. ahaM te praBavAmItyarTaH.
'devo'yaM dinakftkulEkatilako na prABavizyadyadi' (hanumannAwake 1.52). prABavizyad AviraBavizyat, avAtarizyat.
'tato vE teByo yajYaH prABavat' (tE0 brA0 2.2.2.6). prABavat paryApnot.
'raktabIjasya bE kzipraM vaDo hi praBavizyati' (skanda pu0 ke0 86.61). anarTakaH praSabdaH.
'AkASaM prabaBUvATa vimAnESca suSoBitam' (skanda pu0 ke0 88.28). ihApyanarTakaH pro vyavahAraM virunDe.
'vAceme hotre (potfnezwrAKye) praBAvayemeti' (E0 brA0 6.14). praBAvayema samfdDe karavAma.
'fcAgnIDrIyAM praBAvayAYcakruH' (E0 brA0 6.14). praBUtAM cakrurityarTaH.
'ozaDayo vE prajAH praBavantIH pratyABavanti' (tE0 saM0 1.7.2). praBavantIH praBavantyaH praButvopetAH.
'droRasya puNKasaMkASAM praBavantaH SarAsanAt. eko dIrGa ivAdfSyadAkASe saMhataH SaraH' (BA0 vi0 58.41).. praBavantaH=nizkrAmantaH=niHsarantaH. adfSyat=adfSyata.
'tAste (DAnAH) santUdBvIH praBvIH' (aTarva0 18.4.43). praBvIH=praBAvukAH.
'yajYasya praBUtyE' (tE0 brA0 2.2.2.6). praBUtyE paryAptyE.
'astu SezaM kOravARAM mA parABUdidaM kulam' (BA॰u॰123.59). mA naSadityarTaH.
'ekAntena hyanIho'yaM parABavati pUruzaH' (BA॰vana॰32.39). ukto'rTaH .
'katamAsAM BomatamA yAmadattvA parABavet' (aTarva॰12.4.45).
'yaTA te kulatantuSca DarmaScApi na parABavet' (BA॰Adi॰103.22).
'te brAhmaRasya gAM jagDvA vEtahavyAH parABavan' (aTarva॰5.28.20).
'kaTaM nu prajAH sfzwAH parABavanti' (kAWaka॰2.4).
'yamicCeyuH sa rAjA syAdyo nezwaH sa parABavet' (BA॰anu॰33.17).
'nEtad vidvAn parABavet' (BA॰gf॰2.6). etajjAnAno na naSyedityAha.
'te'surA helayo helaya iti kurvantaH parAbaBUvuH' (BAzye). neSurityarTaH.
'yo rAGavaM raRe parABavet' (rA॰3.66.14). parABavatiriha sakarmakaH. jayet=aBiBavet.
'nacirAttaM ripavaH parABavanti' (kA॰nI॰sA॰13.94). ukto'rTaH.
yadutsAhI sadA martyaH parABavati sajjanAn. parABavati=tiraskaroti=aDikzipati.
'indro maRinA'surAn parABAvayat' (aTarva॰8.5.3).
'samBAvya parABAvayattato vE devA aBavan parAsurAH' (E॰brA॰3.39). aBavannavarDanta.  parABavan=ahIyanta=anaSyan.
'anenendro maRinA vftramahannanenAsurAn parABAvayanmanIzI' (aTarva॰8.5.3).
'sapatneByaH parABuve' (aTarva॰1.29.4). parABuve=parABUtaye. sampadAditvAt BAve kvip.
'na cEvaM sAmarA lokA gamizyanti parABavam' (BA॰Adi॰180.20). parABavo nASaH.
'niyacCedaM manaH pApAtsarvalokaparABavAt' (BA॰Adi॰179.21). ukto'rTaH .
'varaM pariBavastasmAnna guRAnAM parABavaH' (avadA॰jA॰33.13). parABavo nASastyAgaH.
'parABavasya hEtanmuKaM yadatimAnaH' (Sa॰brA॰5.1.1.1). parABavo vinipAtaH.
'parEraparyAsitasattvasampadAM parABavo'pyutsava eva mAninAm' (ki॰1.41). parABavaH parAjayaH.
'kuberasya manaHSalyaM SaMsatIva parABavam' (ku॰2.22). parABavaH=tiraskAraH=vimAnanA.
'prAnyAni pAtrARi yujyante nAnyAni yAni parAcInAni prayujyante tAnyanvozaDayaH parA Bavanti yAni punaH prayujyante tAnyanvozaDayaH punarA Bavanti' (tE0 saM0 6.5.11). parABavanti PalapAke vinaSyanti.
'na yajYaH parABavati na yajamAnaH' (tE0 saM0 6.1.5). na parABavati na naSyati.
'mAkirdevAnAmapaBUriha syAH' (f॰10.11.9 ;1.131.7). apaBUH=asmadyajYAd apaBavitA apagantA mA BUdityarTaH.
'apaBUtu durmatiH' (f॰1.131.7). ito dUre'vatizWatAmityAha.
'sapatnA ye me'pa te Bavantu' (aTarva॰4.34.7). apahatA Bavantviti sAyaRaH.
'gfhameDAsa Agata maruto mApaBUtana' (f॰7.59.10). mA'petetyAha.
'paScA mfDo apa Bavantu viSvAH' (aTarva॰20.91.11). apahatA BavantvityarTaH.
'sODanvanA fBavo mApaBUta' (f॰4.35.1). dUre mA sma BavatetyAha.
'yo jyezWabanDurapaBUtaH syAt' (tE0 saM0 3.4.8.28). apaBUto nyakkftaH.
'ihopa yAta Savaso napAtaH sODanvanA fBavo mApa BUta' (f0 4.3.5.1). mApaBUta=dUre mAsma Bavata.
'samBavatyavyayAd vyayam' (manu॰1.19). samBabati=jAyate=utpadyate.
'kumArasya retaH siktaM na samBavati' (Sa॰brA॰11.4.1.7).
'AtmA hi praTamaH samBavataH samBavati' (Sa॰brA॰10.12.4). AtmA=SarIram. samBavataH=utpadyamAnasya. samBavati=utpadyate.
'cakzuH puruzasya praTamaM samBavataH samBavati' (E॰brA॰3.2).
'sa sAttvatyAmatiraTaH sambaBUva DanaYjayAt' (BA॰Adi॰221.86). ukto'rTaH.
'taTA sa rAkzasaSrezWaH SarEH kfttaH punaH punaH. sambaBUva samavApa ca yOvanam' (BA॰BIzma॰90.64-65). sambaBUva=saYjijIva.
'tA asya prajAH sfzwAH stanAvevABipadya sambaBUvuH' (Sa॰brA॰2.5.1.3). aDriyanta, jIvA avatasTire.
'asadevedamagra AsIt, tatsadAsIt, tatsamaBavat' (CAM॰u॰3.19.1). samaBavat=samavarData=vyaktimApadyata.
'na me hastaH samaBavad vasu tat pratigfhRataH' (BA॰saBA॰50.24). samaBavat=prABavat. taTA bfhannAsIdyaTA vasu gfhRIyAd ityAha.
'na yanniyantuM samaBAvi BAnunA' (SiSu॰1.27). na samaBAvi=na Seke. samBavaterBAve luN.
'pakvena saha samBavema' (aTarva॰6.119.2). samBavema=sambadDA Bavema.
'saM te majjA majjYA Bavatu' (aTarva॰4.12.3). samBavatu=saMsfjyatAm.
'samBUyAmBoDimaByeti mahAnadyA nagApagA' (SiSu॰2.100). samBUya=saNgatya.
'aDA mftAH pitfzu samBavantu' (aTarva॰18.4.48). pitfBiH saNgacCantAmityAha.
'aTa punarlozwaM nyasyati pfTivyA samBaveti' (Sa॰brA॰3.2.2.21). pfTivyA saMsfjyasvetyAha.
'kAmamA vijanitoH samBavAma iti strIRAmindradatto varaH' (tE॰saM॰2.5.1.5). samBavanaM miTunIBAvaH.
'tAviha samBavAva prajAmAjanayAvahE' (aTarva॰14.2.71). ukto'rTaH.
'sa vivasvAnAditya ASvameva rUpaM kftvA tAmanusftya sambaBUva' (ni॰1.2.10.2).

'divaM vA uzasaM vA. miTunyenayA syAmiti tAM sambaBUva' (Sa॰brA॰1.7.4.1). atra samBavateH prayoge dvitIyASrutyAmavaDAtavyam. anyatra prAyeRa tftIyA SrUyate - 'prajAvatI patyA samBaveha' (aTarva॰14.2.32).
'maharziH saMvidaM kftvA sambaBUva tayA saha' (BA॰Adi॰177.44).
'sambaBUva tayA sArDaM mAtuH priyacikIrzayA' (BA॰Adi॰106.6).
'sa taTeti pratijYAya tayA samaBavanmuniH' (BA॰vana॰99.23).
'samBaved garBaM DehIti' (drA॰gf॰1.4.16). miTunI BavedityarTaH.
'aTa kAlena mahatA sa matsyaH sumahAnaBUt. aliYjare yaTA cEva nAsO samaBavat kila' (BA॰vana॰187.13).. na samaBavat=nAmAt.
'prasTaM samBavati sTAlI prAsTikI' (pA॰5.1.52). samBavatirihADArAdADeyasyAnatireke vartate.
'KAryAM droRaH samBavati. droRa AQakaM samBavati. sahasra SataM samBavati'. KAryAM droRa ityAdizu samBavatiH samAviSatItyanena samAnABiDeyaH.
'sa (stomaH prajApatiH) idaM sarvaM yuta idaM sarvaM samBavati' (Sa॰brA॰4.2.5.6). samBavati=svasminnantarDatte samAveSayati.
'saM devatrA baBUvaTuH' (f॰1.83.9). devezu maDye sTAna prApnuTetyAha.
'vAjasya nu prasave sambaBUvimemA viSvA BuvanAnyantaH' (aTarva॰3.20.8). sambaBUvima=prAptAH.
'kramAtte samBavantyarcirahaH SuklaM taTottaram' (yAjYa॰3.193). samBavanti=prApnuvanti.
'asya dvizan BrAtfvyo vaRijyayA vA kenacidvA samBavati' (Sa॰brA॰1.6.4.20). samBavati=samfDyati. BUtimAn BavatIti yAvat.
'vAlEH SaNgeRa pAdena samBavatyeva gOrmaKam' (BA॰SAM॰268.28). samBavati=samBAvayati=varDayati.
'sa ca tasminmahezvAsaH kfpaH samaBavattadA' (BA॰ASrama॰1.13). samaBavat=samIpe'Bavat.
'tvaritaH kAmyake pArTAn samaBAvayadacyutaH' (BA॰vana॰51.16). samaBAvayat=samagacCat.
'vatsa ucyatAM BAgurAyaRo yaTA tvaritaM samBAvaya' (mudrA॰praTame'Nke). saNgacCa, AsAdayetyarTaH.
'samBAvayati cAnnena sa vipro gururucyate' (manu॰2.142). samBAvayati=saMvarDayati.
'BaktimAn BfSamarhABirBArgavaM samaBAvayat' (Si॰BA॰29.76). samaBAvayat=sadakarot.
'tadenaM punaH samBAvayanti punarApyAyayantyupasadAM rUpeRa' (E॰brA0.3.32). samBAvanaM sajIvatvaM vfdDirApyAyanaM taTeti zaqguru॰.
'ekANgenApi samBUtaH SatrurdurgamupASritaH' (BA॰SAM॰58.18). samBUtaH sampannaH. ekANgenApi hastyaSvaraTapAdAtAnAmanyatamenApi.
'girinirJarasamBUtA girinirdarivAsinAm. siMhAnAM ninadA duHKAH… (rA॰2.28.7).. samBUtAH=praBUtAH=vfdDiM gatAH. samiha preRa tulyArTam.
'svatejovizasamBUtaH' (rA॰4.31.30) samBUtaH=vyAptaH.
'yaTA paYcasu BUtezu samBUtatvaM niyacCati' (BA॰ASva॰17.21). samBUtatvam=saMhatatvam.
'sa cAyamaBiniveSaH svarasavAhI… pratyakzAnumAnAgamErasamBAvitaH' (yo॰sU॰2.9 vyAsaBAzye). asamBAvitaH=asampAditaH.
'tayA samBAvitA cAsmi snigDayA mAtfsOhfdAt' (rA॰2.118.33). samBAvitA=saMvarDitA.
'budDimohaM samAsTAya tvarAsamBAvito'naGa. gacCa rudrasakASaM tvam…' (BA॰Adi॰223.35).. tvarAsamBAvitaH=tvarAyuktaH.
'samBAvitA jAtabalAste dadyuryadi naH suKam' (BA॰SAM॰7.15). samBAvitAH=pozitAH, saMvarDitAH.
'vIrAH samBAvitAtmAno na dEvaM paryupAsate' (rA॰2.23.16). SOryAdiguRErlokasya vanditasvarUpA ityAha.
'samBAvitasya cAkIrtirmaraRAdatiricyate' (gItA॰2.34). samBAvitasya=mahitasya.
'badDuM na samBAvitaH keSapASaH' (raGa॰7.6). samBAvitaH=cintitaH.
'cirapraboDAnna samBAvitamasmABiradya DarmAsanamaDyAsitum' (SA॰6). DarmAsanADyAsanasya mayA karizyamAraRasya samBavo nABUdityAha.
'asamBAvitAtiTisatkAraM lajje'hamAryaM vijYApayitum' (SA॰). asamBAvito'kfto'tiTisatkAro yasya tam.
'arTapratyayo hi varRErniyatakramatayA parasparamasamBavadBiraSakyaH kartum' (3.17 yo॰BA॰vAcaspatiH). asamBavadBiH=AyujyamAnEH.
'kzIrasamBAvanArTAya kfttikAH samayojayan' (rA॰1.37.23). kzIrasamBAvanArTAya=kzIrapAnaprayojanasidDaye. samBAvanaM saMyojanaM prApaRam.
'pitaraM karkawo hanti mAtaraM hanti puttikA. hanti sarvaM tu kAyasTaH kftaGnaH prAptasamBabaH' (rAja॰8.89). prAptasamBavaH=avAptaBUtikaH.
'niHSvAsAyAsasamBavaH' (viyogAgniH) (rA॰2.24.7). samBavaH=vfdDiH.
'UrDvaM trirAtrAtsamBava ityeke' (go॰gf॰2.5.7,8). samBavaH=miTunIBAvaH, mETunyam.
'sa pretya paSutAM yAti samBavAnekaviMSatim' (manu॰5.35). samBavAn janmAni.
'Srutarzayastu Bavanti kecit karmaPalaSezeRa punaH samBave' (Apa॰Da॰1.5.5). samBavo janma. punaH samBavaH=punarBavaH=pretyaBAvaH.
'sa evaM vidvAMSCandomayo devatAmayo brahmamayaH samBUya devatA apyeti' (E॰brA॰2.42). samBUya=samyag BUtvA.
'samBAvya cawakAnmUrDni' (BA॰SAM॰261.41). samBAvya=varDayitvA.
'samBAvya putrAn kAlena' (BA॰SAM॰288.8). samBAvya=saMvarDya.
'vilocanaM dakziRamaYjanena samBAvya' (ku.॰7.59, raGu॰7.8). samBAvya=satkftya=alaNkftya.
'yena samBAvyamAnena prapannAnDaM tamaH praBo' (BA॰pu॰3.25.7). samBAvyamAnena=pUryamARena.
'tAnasaBAvyaM parABAvayat' (E॰brA॰3.39). punaH samfdDiH samBAvyaM tadrahitaM yaTA syAttaTA.
'samBAvanA hi lokasya mama pArTasya coBayoH' (BA॰droRa॰110.96). samBAvanA'stitAjYAnaM kulaSIlaSrutAdizu iti nIla॰.
'siDyanti karmasu mahatsvapi yanniyojyAH samBAvanAguRamavehi tamISvarARAm' (SA॰7.4). samBAvanA=gOravam, samAdaraH.
'samBAvanamaTotprekzA prakftasya pareRa yat' (sA॰da॰10.40).
samBUtiM tasya tAM vidyAd yadyAnAvaBijAyate' (manu॰2.147). samBUtirjanma.
'saM jyotizA'BUvam' (tE0 saM0 1.7.6.3). samaBUvam=samagaMsi.
'so'syAtmA'muzminnAditye saMBavati' (jE0 brA0 1.17). saMBavati jAyate.
indraSca vfhacca (sAma) samaBavatAm' (paYca0 brA0 12.13.1). samaBavatAM sAkamajAyetAm.
'devASca vA asurAScAsparDanta yaM devAnAmaGnan na sa samaBavat, yamasurARAM saM so'Bavat' (paYca0 brA0 12.5.23). samaBavat samajIvat, punarjIvo'Bavat.
'jYAtuM devaM saMBavanti vadantyevaM purAtanAH' (Sivapu0 2.2.36.26). saMBavanti praBavanti.
'kzipra evaM samBavati' (SAM0 brA0 1.1). saMBavati samfDyati, BUtimAn Bavati. aByudayate.
'saMvidAne rodasI saM baBUvatuH' (tE0 brA0 1.2.1.23). sambaBUvatuH=ekI baBUvatuH.
'agnIzomO samaBavatAm' (tE0 saM0 2.3.3.1). EkamatyaM jagmatuH.
'iyaM te Sukra tanUridaM varcastayA saMBava' (tE0 saM0 1.2.4). saMBava saNgacCasva.
'velAnilaH ketakareRuBiste samBAvayatyAnanamAyatAkzi' (raGu0 13.16). samBAvayati alaMkaroti.
'anenasaM vijYAya tAM tvAzwrImaSvarUpiRIm. sa harirharirUpeRa muKena samaBAvayat' (skandapu0 kA0 4.17.118).. samaBAvayat mETunaM cakAra. hariH sUryaH. harirUpeRASvarUpeRa.
'yaduktamapi ca yadetad vakzyamARam iti utaSabda evamuBayaM saMBAvayati' (ni0 4.15.2 ityatra durgaH). saMBAvayati yojayati.
